steps: Halve and pit 2 Avocados, then scoop the flesh into a medium bowl.
Peel and break 1 Banana into chunks; add to the bowl with the avocado.
Smash avocado and banana together with a fork until mostly smooth.
Stir in 15 ml Lemon juice to keep the colour bright.
Add 30 ml Coconut milk and stir until the mixture is creamy.
Sprinkle in 15 g Chia seeds and stir well to combine.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes so the chia seeds begin to thicken it.
Spoon into 4 small cups or bowls and serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 1 day.
